noRegister.title: This device is not linked to a register
noRegister.description: A manager must pair this device to a location and register under Devices.

offline.banner: The connection is down. Sales cannot be taken until it returns (offline mode is coming). Your cart is saved.

pending.banner: A payment is not confirmed yet. Checking again never charges twice.
pending.locked: The cart cannot be changed until the payment is confirmed.
pending.pricesUpdated: Prices were updated. Review the cart and take payment again.
pending.approvalExpired: The approval expired. Ask a manager to enter their PIN again.
pending.shiftClosed: The shift is not open. Open a shift first.

search.label: Find a product
search.lookupFailed: Could not look up the product. Check the connection.

qty.invalidWeighed: Enter a quantity above 0 with up to 3 decimals.
qty.invalidPieces: Enter a whole number of pieces.

price.description: Listed price: {price}. Changing the price needs manager approval.
price.label: New unit price
price.approvalHint: Every price change is confirmed by a manager PIN.

discount.description: Give a discount as a percentage or an amount.
discount.invalidFixed: The amount must be above 0 and no more than what is being discounted.

approval.title: Manager approval
approval.description: A manager enters their own PIN on this device.
approval.invalidPin: Wrong PIN, or this person may not approve this.

cart.title: Cart
cart.emptyHint: Tap a product, search or scan a barcode.
cart.open: Open cart: {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}

tender.title: Take payment
tender.description: Choose how the customer pays. A sale can be split across methods.
tender.unknownBody: The server could not be reached. The sale may already be recorded. Checking again never charges twice.

errors.cashUnits: Cash amounts must be a multiple of the smallest coin.
errors.exceeds: The amount is more than the remaining {remaining}.
errors.reference: A transfer reference is required for bank transfers.
errors.generic: The sale could not be recorded ({code}).
errors.unknown: No answer received. Please check again.
errors.tenders: The payments do not add up to the amount due.

qpay.scan: Scan the QR code with QPay or a bank app to pay {amount}.
qpay.createFailed: Could not create the QPay invoice. Please try again.

success.title: Sale completed
success.needsReview: A manager needs to review this sale.

held.title: Held carts
held.description: Your parked sales on this register.
held.full: Too many held carts. Discard one first.
held.pricesChanged: Prices changed while the cart was on hold and were updated.

camera.title: Scan with camera
camera.description: Hold the barcode in front of the camera. Scanned products are added to the cart.
camera.unsupported: This browser cannot use the camera (or the page is not on a secure connection). Use a barcode scanner or search instead.
camera.denied: Camera access was denied. Allow it in the browser settings.
camera.error: The camera could not be started.

help.title: Keyboard shortcuts
help.scanner: A USB barcode scanner works anywhere on the screen: a scan adds the product straight away.
help.quantity: Type “3*barcode” in search to add 3 pieces.

shift.title: Open shift
shift.description: {register}: count the cash in the drawer before the first sale.

clearConfirm.title: Clear the cart?
clearConfirm.description: All items will be removed from the cart.

errorBoundary.cartSaved: Your cart is saved. Retrying will pick up where you left off.
